$comment: One canonical implementation per OPERATION (#5123, epic #5121). The unit is the operation, not the symbol — CLAUDE.md's old table listed symbols, which is how it blessed both sides of adapter acquisition. Alternates record PRESENCE only, never call-site counts: counts make two unrelated PRs touching the same alternate conflict, and a gate that punishes uninvolved developers gets disabled. Reseed with: npx tsx scripts/check-concern-registry.ts baseline

concerns.question: What do I call to turn token counts into a USD figure?

detect.note: Matches the ARITHMETIC - a token identifier combined with a rate - not a declaration, a pass-through, or a comment describing it. Earlier drafts flagged five files that merely declare or forward `costPer1KTokens`, two that round to micro-USD (`Math.round(usd * 1_000_000) / 1_000_000`), one converting nanoseconds to milliseconds, and one doc comment. Comments are stripped before matching.

alternates.why: Blended per-1K rate on totalTokens from a table the observer maintains itself, discarding a split its caller holds.
Subsystem-local per-1K helper (tokensToCostUsd). Collapsed from three inline constants in #5171; absorbs into the core when the observer decision lands.
